title: Fields every deploy status file carries
description: Shared by app-status and resource-status. Each of those narrows `result` to its own vocabulary, and lists these keys under its own `properties` (as `true`) so its `additionalProperties: false` admits them; the constraints are here.

timestamp.description: UTC, second precision, as Ansible's date_time.iso8601 and now(utc=True, fmt='%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') both write it.

gate.description: Human-readable reason nothing was installed, or a short status ('ok', 'up to date'). May be ''.

gate_code.description: Machine-readable form of `gate`, from a closed set. The mapping from gate text and result to code is A-GATE-1 in AGREEMENTS.md.

failed_step.description: The task that failed and its error, or '' when nothing failed.

failed_attempts.description: Consecutive failures of the current target. A JSON number.
